summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted a Pittsburg Leader interview with Sam French, Joe Goss's old backer, who discussed Goss's September 7 fight with Tom Allen for $5,000 and their 1867 draw.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, August 30, 1876. Reprinted from the Pittsburg Leader.

facts.fact: Allen was matched to fight Joe Goss on September 7, 1876 for a $5,000 purse, within a hundred miles of Cincinnati, probably in Kentucky
Allen's first fight with Joe Goss, about nine years earlier, was declared a draw after Goss dislocated his shoulder on a ring stake and fought on one-armed for twenty-three minutes

notes: Account of the 1867 draw is French's partisan, secondhand view (he says Allen was badly beaten at the time).
